neighbours.label: summing or accumulating parts into a whole ('the sum of', 'accumulating over', list.append in a loop)
fire: Happiness is more than the sum of a few pleasant moments.
By accumulating small gains over decades, the fund grew enormously.
The final score is the sum of the points from all five rounds.
Traits passed down and accumulating over generations shaped the species.
Short words put together into short stories help children read.
The team is greater than the sum of its individual players.
quiet: Happiness is more than a matter of a few pleasant moments.
By avoiding small losses over decades, the fund grew enormously.
The final score is the highest of the points from all five rounds.
Traits that faded and disappeared over generations shaped the species.
Short words read aloud in short stories help children read.
The team is better than the average of its individual players.
